articles.title: Cisco Stock Looks Strong, But One Number Says Be Careful
articles.summary: After an 87% run over the last year (as of June 18), it’s hard to find much fault with Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock. The company is posting record revenue, and its AI-related orders are surging. But when a stock is priced for perfection, sitting near its high, the most important signals are often the quiet ones that run counter to the main story.
